title: Counterexamples for Boolean-network variable elimination

kinds.finite-computation: Recomputed for the six supplied fixtures; not a formally verified algorithm.
kinds.earlier-computation: Reported from earlier runs whose records are bundled; these commands do not repeat those runs.
kinds.scope: A definition or limitation of this package, not a new theorem.

definitions.update: asynchronous; change one coordinate only if its update differs
definitions.elimination: functional substitution for a variable with no essential self-dependency
definitions.MAA: complex terminal SCC not contained in any inclusion-minimal coordinate trap space
definitions.D1: MAA(F) is empty and MAA(G) is nonempty
definitions.D2: exists A_prime in MAA(G): forall A in MAA(F), not (A_prime <= projection(A))
definitions.D2_attribution: lab tracking convention, not a definition attributed to the cited papers
definitions.C1: the eliminated variable is on no directed cycle in the essential interaction graph
definitions.C2: MED and INMON and OUTMON, as defined in README.md

not_claimed: novelty or priority of the examples
a new sufficient safety condition for elimination
a general result for networks with n >= 5
that this package replays the earlier exhaustive enumeration or proves its coverage
human expert review or formal proof
numerical blinding of the earlier independent implementation

claims.statement: All six supplied fixtures match their fixed expected truth tables, transitions, attractors, trap spaces, minimal trap spaces, MAAs, interaction conditions, projected original MAAs, and D1/D2.
E1 and its transformed copy satisfy C1 and C2; E2 satisfies C2; E3 satisfies C1 and C2. Each has no original MAA and one reduced MAA after eliminating a.
For C1 and for C2, the minimum original variable count of a D2 counterexample is four, according to the earlier exhaustive n <= 3 calculations together with E1 and E2.
claims.qualification: Saved computation records, not a replayable enumeration certificate. Original enumeration code is not included. No edge-minimality or E3-minimality claim.

claims.statement: The earlier verifier used separately written algorithms for the examples and n <= 3 enumeration, but saw aggregate n=3 counts when extracting definitions.
claims.qualification: This packaging follows both reports. The regression tests and fresh-reader wording review add no independent scientific verification.

claims.statement: Sixteen tests include a second algorithm for all twelve original/reduced profiles and deliberate damage to expected values and formulas.
claims.qualification: Written after the results were known; not a blind review.

claims.statement: Requiring the deleted variable and every descendant to lie on no directed cycle is a post hoc condition close to known downstream-output pruning. No novelty or general theorem for it is claimed.
